The '''Intellex ship-configuration computer''',<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids" /> also known simply as the '''Intellex''', was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] designed by [[Industrial Intelligence/Legends|Industrial Intelligence]] as an advanced "housekeeping" system for [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was small, capable of sorting incredible amounts of information, and featured a system that allowed it to adapt and improve existing computer configurations. This original system held 200 starship configurations and could perform 7,000 MPF operations a second. After the company's merger with [[Automata Galactica/Legends|Automata Galactica]] to form [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], data on the Intellex was sealed away in an encrypted memory vault containing Industrial Intelligence's biggest secrets. After Automata Galactica sliced some of the files inside the vault, they found the Intellex and [[Intellex II|adapted]] it as the [[Intellex|droid brain]] for the prototype [[P2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" />
